qa_pair.question: Among all genres in the bookstore's catalog, which genre has the most titles, and how many titles does that genre have? Answer in the form "<genre>, <count>".
Which author's books have generated the most revenue across delivered orders, and what is that revenue in US dollars rounded to two decimals? Answer in the form "<author name>, <revenue>".
Which single book has sold the most copies through delivered orders, and how many copies were sold? Answer in the form "<title>, <copies>".
How many customers joined the bookstore before January 1, 2024? Answer with just the number.
What is the combined value of all orders that are still pending, rounded to two decimals? Answer with just the amount, e.g. 123.45.
Which book has the fewest copies left in stock, and how many copies remain? Answer in the form "<title>, <stock>".
Which customer living in Lagos has bought the most books through delivered orders, and how many copies did they buy? Answer in the form "<customer name>, <copies>".
Which authors have at least one book whose copies have never been sold through a delivered order? List their names in alphabetical order, comma-separated.
qa_pair.answer: Haruki Murakami, Italo Calvino, Toni Morrison

qa_pair.question: What is the average price of the books published before 1980, rounded to two decimals? Answer with just the amount, e.g. 12.34.
Which genre brought in the most revenue from delivered orders, and what was that revenue rounded to two decimals? Answer in the form "<genre>, <revenue>".
If every book title is listed in alphabetical order and the results are read two at a time, which two titles come third and fourth? Answer in the form "<third>, <fourth>".
